'''Fezrik Bendledon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Fezrik was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that dealt under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] nose and even hired Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to work for him on occasion. He worked through several contacts to get the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan's]] what they want and as long as the Empire was kept in cheap labor they allowed the illegal activity to slide.
